# Sofia Serenata — Sofia Gallego, violin & voice for events

> Sofia Gallego is a singer (lyric soprano) and violinist based in Paris, performing live at weddings, receptions, cocktails, private and corporate events across Paris and Île-de-France. She has more than 20 years on stage in Chile, Switzerland, the United States and France, and sings in five languages.

## What she offers
- Solo: violin or voice for a ceremony, cocktail or background atmosphere (guide price from €200)
- Duo: voice + piano, or violin + guitar, for cocktails and receptions (from €400)
- Ensemble: string quartet, choir or a custom ensemble (from €800)
- Custom arrangements for a first dance, an entrance or any special moment
- Can come self-contained with sound for intimate spaces, or work with the venue's technical team

Prices are guides and depend on duration, venue and setup.

## Repertoire
Classical (Bach, Mozart, Puccini, opera and zarzuela), French chanson (Piaf), Latin American songs, and international pop (Coldplay, Taylor Swift and more). The full, searchable list with audio previews is on the homepage.

## Background
Soloist in operas, zarzuelas and musical theatre; chamber music; recordings (Música Andalusí) and television appearances in Chile (TVN, Canal 13); performances at Teatro Municipal La Serena, Semanas Musicales de Frutillar and hotels such as the Ritz-Carlton. Also an astrophysicist and writer — see sofiagallego.com.
